root_cause.evidence: The patch moves `kfree(dev_path)` to the `end` label and initializes `dev_path` to NULL, ensuring it is freed even on the `-ENOSPC` error path; the CVE description explicitly states that returning -ENOSPC without freeing the allocated memory results in a leak.
